feed.handoffDetail: The relay packaged {name}'s workflow, proposed app, and design stylesheet into one brief. It started Google's hosted Antigravity agent on {model} in a 4 vCPU, 16 GB Linux sandbox. The console follows live thought summaries, tool calls, files written, tokens, page snapshots, and the progress file.
